Montrusco Bolton Investments Maintains Position in Biogen (BIIB); Bank Amer (BAC) Holder Bedell Frazier Investment Counseling Has Decreased Position by $725,464 as Market Value Declined
June 15, 2018 - By Henry Gaston
Montrusco Bolton Investments Inc increased its stake in Biogen Inc (BIIB) by 28.92% based on its latest 2018Q1 regulatory filing with the SEC. Montrusco Bolton Investments Inc bought 10,713 shares as the company’s stock declined 1.31% with the market. The institutional investor held 47,758 shares of the biological products (no diagnostic substances) company at the end of 2018Q1, valued at $13.05 million, up from 37,045 at the end of the previous reported quarter. Montrusco Bolton Investments Inc who had been investing in Biogen Inc for a number of months, seems to be bullish on the $64.67 billion market cap company. The stock increased 0.26% or $0.8 during the last trading session, reaching $306.48. About 937,578 shares traded. Biogen Inc. (NASDAQ:BIIB) has risen 13.14% since June 15, 2017 and is uptrending. It has outperformed by 0.57% the S&P500.
